hedgerow_supper.paper_save_rule: Spend out every turn, except keep what next turn's scheduled Tier up needs beyond next turn's income (rounds 3, 6, 9 and 11). Hold every Larder item: cash one only to pay a scheduled Tier up, or to buy alderman_dozey, dr_urchin, squire_lollop or goodman_hayward. From round 12, refresh freely with spare gold.
hedgerow_supper.implemented_save: Actual next discounted tier-up cost minus next income and promised income, including low-health seats. Native committed lines prevent spend-all spells and paid powers from consuming this reserve; ordinary Hard retains its existing policy.
hedgerow_supper.status: Implemented; targeted tests pass and same-32-seed B rerun completed on dec5f2c9.
hedgerow_supper.refresh_policy: Ordinary Hard limit before R12; from R12 refresh freely subject to available gold, climb savings and the shared 60-action recruit budget. The refresh price is unchanged.
hedgerow_supper.sergeant_policy: Cash below an available Stash, or below an available Great Hoard for a target holding over one third of enemy stats, only when the enemy across the Sergeant exceeds three times our median body. A private snapshot of the legitimate pre-turn scout supplies this named decision; placement and search remain blind. The snapshot is cleared after placement. Wake-turn feeding remains first, so ammunition is prepared from items still held afterwards.
hedgerow_supper.fuel_policy: First Partner remains an R1–R3 purchase and is played into B1 without moving another clock. Pym remains a buy through R6; completing triples retain their exception. Declared engines, Partner, Pym and Dozey are excluded from generic Belly routing on both purchase and hand-play paths. Held Larder policy starts before the first Hedgerow body. No offer forcing, new draw weights or rate changes.

hedgerow_parish.paper_save_rule: Spend out every turn; keep only what next turn's scheduled Tier up needs beyond next turn's income. Refresh up to twice a turn, more only to find standing_committee at tier 5 or squire_lollop at tier 6.
hedgerow_parish.implemented_save: Actual next discounted tier-up cost minus next income and promised income, including low-health seats. Native committed lines prevent spend-all spells and paid powers from consuming this reserve; ordinary Hard retains its existing policy.
hedgerow_parish.status: Implemented; targeted tests pass and same-32-seed B rerun completed on dec5f2c9.
hedgerow_parish.refresh_policy: At most two per turn; additional refreshes only while Committee is missing at tier 5, or Lollop is missing at tier 6. Re-evaluated after every purchase.

followup_audit.decision: ideation/main eaea0e05, DECISIONS: Hedgerow light pass (A2), asks 2–3; C10 keeps live T6 price 13.
followup_audit.review_discrepancy: The archived compact rows recompute to 11 of 13 late seats with zero R9 gold, versus 12 of 13 in the review. Seed 282017 seat 7 has 1 gold at tier 4; seed 282027 seat 0 has 3 gold at tier 5. This audit preserves those rows rather than rewriting the reviewed claim.
followup_audit.diagnosis: The low-health waiver applies to only one archived late seat, so it cannot explain the cohort alone. Source inspection and directed states identify reserve bypasses in spend-all spell casting and non-spare power plans. The old compact rows lack recruit action logs and per-turn upgrade costs, so individual zero-bank seats cannot be attributed to those paths conclusively. A late tier-5 arrival can need two gold where an on-time arrival needs one; no flat reserve is added.
followup_audit.partner_evidence: 28 of 128 Supper R3–R6 rows contain Partner, representing 7 seats throughout those four rounds. No Partner/Pym/Dozey/Urchin appears inside a Belly in archived Supper R3–R8 rows, so the Belly change is prevention, not an asserted cause of the baseline fuel shortage. Per-card offered counts were not archived, so lack of availability is not distinguished from declined offers.

followup_audit.confirmed_opener_gap: The committed engine opener buys Rainy Day for one gold before considering units. At R1 with three gold this makes an offered three-gold Partner unaffordable. Native Supper now prioritizes an actually offered, affordable first Partner within its existing R1–R3 window; other and frozen-line openers remain unchanged. The directed actual-pipeline case fails before this guard. Per-card baseline offers are absent, so the number of historical seats affected is not claimed.
followup_audit.median_convention: Sergeant and post-wake carry placement use the statistical median of all active friendly bodies, averaging the two central bodies on even boards, matching BotBog. The Sergeant fixed case has bodies 3,6,7,9 and a 20-stat target, so the threshold is 19.5 rather than upper-middle 21.

baseline_interval_method.method: 90% percentile intervals (5th/95th, linear type-7 quantiles), sampling with replacement. Primary and individual diagnostic resample matched (seed, seat) R8/R14 pairs together, using the same sampled pairs for both metrics and estimates. These are seats observed alive entering R14, not inferred final winners. Changing-survivor estimates resample whole lobby seeds with both endpoints, preserving within-lobby observations and missing/eliminated seats. All recorded lobby seeds participate, including early-ended lobbies. No absent seats become zeros. Null/zero starting medians produce undefined draws; intervals use valid draws only and disclose their count. Individual growth omits zero-start pairs. No cross-arm difference interval is implied.
